prerequisite.reason: All eight allowed intents (five constant caps and three predeclared 2Hz sequences) reach the unchanged |principal strain|>.02 limit during actual soft-foot loading, before completing the outbound leg.
prerequisite.implementation_evidence: The native pre-attachment model and MPC binary SHA256 exactly match R8 S3; actual soft GRF and applied material-force records agree at every integrated step; parameters and .2 ms truth integration are unchanged; constitutive residuals remain below 1e-8.
prerequisite.domain_failure_semantics: The last attempted material boundary is saved with current robot time t and material time t+.0002. Its out-of-domain force is not applied or integrated into the robot. Each run therefore has one more material-boundary sample than physical integration steps.
prerequisite.permitted_scope: No evidenced adapter defect remains in these records. Changing the contact law, material domain, S3 gait/controller or physics step is outside the frozen R9 contract. The remaining five predeclared full-mission intent attempts also failed; the eight-start material-adaptation cap is exhausted.
prerequisite.inference_limit: These eight intents are not an impossibility proof for every possible policy; the required feasible complete-task domain was not established within the entire authorized adaptation allowance.

unexecuted.reasons: Physical material prerequisite failed and 8/8 adaptation starts are used. The 48h overall wall-clock cap is not exhausted.
